note: The Cook Islands: every visitor enters without a visa for up to 31 days (tourists may extend by 31 days at a time up to 6 months, not modelled), New Zealand citizens for 90 days. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of New Zealand
sources.said: All visitors to the Cook Islands may enter without a visa for up to 31 days, with the exception of New Zealand citizens, who are permitted to enter without a visa for up to 90 days.
